# Drive Music

> A personal music player for the audio files in your own Google Drive. It streams and caches tracks straight from Drive, mixes them like a DJ, and syncs what is playing across your devices. No server-side database, no ads, no tracking.

Drive Music signs in with Google and asks only for read-only Drive access. Audio, playlists and the listening model stay on the device, in IndexedDB.

## Features

- Plays audio from your Google Drive, with offline downloads per track or in bulk
- DJ-style auto mix: track analysis (BPM, key), beatmatching, crossfades and a per-transition editor
- Gapless playback, volume normalization, a 3-band equalizer and spatial audio
- Playlists, favorites, a Drive folder browser and an offline library with search
- An on-device recommendation model that weights shuffle by what you actually listen to
- Cross-device "now playing" sync and "Play here"
- Eight themes, installable as an app (PWA)

## How it works

- Sign in with Google. Drive Music asks for read-only Drive access (`drive.readonly`): it can list folders and download the audio files you open, and cannot create, edit, move or delete anything.
- Tracks stream from Drive through a Web Audio chain: crossfade (0–12 s), volume normalization that boosts quiet tracks, a 3-band equalizer (±12 dB), convolver-based spatial widening and a live visualizer.
- Downloads, playlists, favorites, listening history and the recommendation model are stored in the browser's IndexedDB, on the device only. There is no server-side database of your library.
- The recommendation model is a small neural network trained on the device from what you actually play; it weights shuffle and fills the "Made For You" shelf.
- "Listen together" works like Spotify Connect across your own devices: pick which device plays and control it, including its volume, from any other.
- Installable as a PWA; downloaded tracks play offline, even after a reload without a network.

## Privacy, in short

- Google data is used only to provide the features above, following the Google API Services User Data Policy (Limited Use): no ads, never sold, never read by people.
- "Listen together" relays play/pause, position, volume and the current queue between your own devices in a private room named by a one-way hash of your email; the room keeps only the latest playback state so another device can resume.
- Page views and load timing are counted by the site's own analytics, without cookies or identifiers; a visit's hash changes daily.
- Settings → Clear all data wipes everything stored in the browser; remove the app at https://myaccount.google.com/permissions to revoke Drive access.

## Terms, in short

A free personal project, provided as is, with no guarantee of availability. You are responsible for having the rights to the files in your Drive. Source code: https://github.com/ChakkritGit/drive-music
